fullPassage: It is important to recognize that although science is a rule-based procedure, it is very much a creative process. A conjecture is a philosophical invention, cooked up rather mystically by the mind through the mental computation we call careful contemplation. However, until the hypothesis is tested against reality, it is not yet truly knowledge; it is just information that represents speculation. Knowledge is information that has demonstrated its usefulness. It is what is left over after cycles of experimental testing have eliminated false theories. As scientists continually test their hypotheses and modify their models to account for new and surprising data, a kind of 'learning loop' emerges that statisticians call Bayesian updating. Based on Bayes' Rule, developed by eighteenth-century English statistician and philosopher Thomas Bayes, Bayesian updating refers to a mathematical process whereby an accepted theory or predictive model gets increasingly accurate through the repetitive testing of competing variants of that theory.

det.tip: accurate(정확한) ↔ erroneous(오류가 있는)

questions.passage: It is important to recognize that although science is a rule-based procedure, it is very much a creative process. A conjecture is a philosophical invention, cooked up rather mystically by the mind through the mental computation we call careful contemplation. However, until the hypothesis is tested against reality, it is not yet truly knowledge; it is just information that represents speculation. Knowledge is information that has demonstrated its usefulness. It is what is left over after cycles of experimental testing have <u>eliminated</u> false theories. As scientists continually test their hypotheses and modify their models to account for new and surprising data, a kind of 'learning loop' emerges that statisticians call Bayesian updating. Based on Bayes' Rule, developed by eighteenth-century English statistician and philosopher Thomas Bayes, Bayesian updating refers to a mathematical process whereby an accepted theory or predictive model gets increasingly accurate through the repetitive testing of competing variants of that theory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 eliminated와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

❌ ③ discarded: '폐기된' — eliminated의 유의어
❌ ④ excluded: '배제된' — eliminated의 유의어
det.tip: eliminated(제거된) ↔ retained(유지된)

questions.passage:
(A) Scientists continually test their hypotheses and modify their models to <u>account</u> for new and surprising data.

(B) She opened a savings <u>account</u> at the bank to prepare for her retirement.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 account의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 설명하다 — (B) 계좌: (A)에서 account for는 '새 데이터를 설명하다'라는 동사구, (B)에서 account는 '은행 계좌'라는 명사 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 설명하다 — (B) 이야기: (B)는 savings account이므로 이야기가 아닌 계좌
❌ ③ (A) 계산하다 — (B) 계좌: (A)에서 account for new data는 '계산하다'가 아닌 '설명하다'
❌ ④ (A) 계산하다 — (B) 이야기: (A), (B) 둘 다 의미가 맞지 않음
det.tip: account for = 설명하다 (동사구) / savings account = 저축 계좌 (명사)

❌ ② conclusion: '결론' — 조사의 끝점이지 출발점이 아님
❌ ③ evidence: '증거' — 설명이 아니라 사실을 뒷받침하는 자료
